# Anivora 0.1.30 — Remote avatars and a smaller APK

- Load the 280 character portraits on demand from the public Anivora-Assets repository. Avatar catalog additions and art updates no longer require an APK release.
- Replace 28.26 MB of bundled PNG atlases with six small offline default portraits (about 69 KB). The picker uses a virtualized grouped grid, loading/error states and Retry.
- Cache the validated public catalog for twelve hours. Refresh stale catalogs in the background, retain them on network failure, and show bundled defaults on first launch offline or failed images.
- Preserve all 0.1.29 avatar IDs and the 74 legacy migration aliases. Profiles and comments keep using the existing avatarUri field with stable avatar IDs. Only configured HTTPS static image URLs are loaded.
- Preserve GitHub Releases updates, Cloudflare public pages, direct on-device manga providers and backend status notices. No avatar image bytes or APK downloads are served through Render.

Assets: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora-Assets

Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brandon-300/Anivora-Assets/main/avatars/manifest.json

To add art, publish a small WebP/JPEG with a unique permanent ID, add its manifest entry, increase the catalog version and update updatedAt. No APK release is needed. See docs/remote-avatars.md in the source repository for publishing and CI setup.

Android version code: **32**. Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The release process verifies the existing signing certificate for installation over earlier Anivora versions. Install over the existing app; do not uninstall or clear data.

Validation runs TypeScript, lint, Expo dependency checks and Expo Doctor, app/backend tests, native JVM and Android emulator integration, and APK package/version/signature/architecture/alignment and compiled-source checks before publication. The public publisher verifies the uploaded APK checksum and unauthenticated download before advancing latest.json.

Physical Infinix Hot 50i/XOS installation and rendering have not been tested. Backend-dependent account/comment/sync availability still depends on Render service health. Cached image files may be evicted by Android; unavailable images show a bundled default. Historical arbitrary external profile-image URLs now show a local default unless they use the configured assets host/path.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/5f1c441914a98447f38151b07832921a460d4151
